## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.19.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.19.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.19.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.19.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.19 build (0.19.0, 0.19.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **Every campaign's crises follow the decision loop.** Week 4 tests Notice,
  week 8 Interpret, week 12 Decide and week 16 Act (counts double). Trust is
  no longer tested at the end. Some crisis stories swapped weeks to fit their
  area. New crises in the campaign editor follow the same order. Balance over
  200 computer games per campaign, Blue win rate: Typhoon Ines 47%, Valmora
  60%, Varrin Reef 46%, Port Sabre 44%, Winter Grid 50%, Lake Referendum 42%,
  Survey Ship 49%, Vell Valley 48%.
- **Gauge rings show how firmly each node is held.** The ring fills clockwise
  from the top in the colour of the side it leans to; a full ring is 100. A
  contested node's empty track is dashed amber.
- **A clearer screen.** More of the map is free, without going to the
  Minimal layout:
  - **Decision Health** is two glowing bars under the crisis bar, Blue on the
    left and Olvana on the right, mirrored, in the colours of the nodes. No
    boxes.
  - **The side panel is narrower and flush to the right edge.** Top to
    bottom: the other mind with your footholds; AREAS TAKEN, a bar from the
    opponent +2 to you +2 that shows the race to an early win (it replaces
    LEAD 0/2, which only moved once a side was already two areas ahead); the
    mind on the big map with its state and Lessons Learned as three diamonds;
    the five area bars; what your Lessons Learned level buys; and the next
    crisis in one line. Decision Health is not repeated there, and "Decides
    in" and the Areas × Trust line are gone.
  - **Under the mini map**, only what to do: each node under pressure and
    the card that helps.
  - **Budget and moves** sit flush bottom right, under the side panel.
  - **The log** moved bottom left and opens and closes from its header,
    WHAT HAS HAPPENED. It is grouped by week, each week folds, and ◉ on any
    move opens its full story. New technologies are rows in the week they
    arrived. This week's orders always sit just above it.
  - **Their edge on you** folds from its header. Where the opponent has been
    aiming, hidden sleeper stories and flooding moved into it.
- **Card tooltips say what a card does**, in plain words, with no numbers. The
  hotkey numbers are gone from the cards; keys 1 to 8 still work.
- **The decision-loop overlay is drawn on top** of the map, with a dark edge
  so the outlines and loop arrows read clearly.
- **More info stays reachable.** The node preview in the side panel stays for
  a moment after the pointer leaves the node, and for as long as the pointer
  is on the panel. Folds you open there stay open.
- The speed setting is now called **Red turn speed**.
- Tutorial, Field Manual, Practitioner's Manual and Player Aid updated.
  Crisis areas changed, so two-player codes work only between 0.19 builds.
